Fixes #1021.

## Resources

[Rule source]()
[Documentation source]()

body: We definitely shouldn't just ignore it. Let's remove the unnecessary directory creation. If it's absolutely necessary, we should at least use [mktemp](https://github.com/sasaplus1/mktemp) and remove the directory afterwards.
Yeah, that should be removed. Nice catch.
The fact that it's not being cleaned up is also causing the cli tests to fail when run more than once, unless you manually remove the gstest folder.

I was going to correct the tests, but I'm not entirely sure what they're testing. Is the first test added in #1030 supposed to be verifying that exit:1 when the provided report path is a directory? Or just that exit:1 when it already exists, directory or no? The code itself doesn't seem to specifically check if the path is a directory, unless there's a nuance of mkdirp I don't know about.
It's checking that there is no file output if there's not a valid filepath passed to `-o`. Agreed, this probably needs a bit of cleanup.
Sorry for the multiple comments, GitHub wasn't showing any change when I hit comment button, so I hit it a couple times. :)

So, "valid" in this case == doesn't already exist? It seems like you would want to overwrite a normal file if you pass it as the output param, otherwise you'd have to go to the trouble of manually deleting it every time you run eslint the same way. But it also makes sense that you wouldn't want to blow away a directory. So it should probably explicitly check for a directory, right?

(Also you can delete comments with the 'x' at the top right of them.)
Alright, I'll add an explicit check for directory.

issue.title: Fix: Check output file isn't already a directory, handle errors, fix and add tests
